notes: CURRENT prices: tariff T651.11 (Conditions générales de vente unireso), edition 01.06.2026, chapter 9. Identical on unireso.com/titres-de-transport and tpg.ch/fr/tarifs-titres-de-transport (read 10.11.2026) and in the leaflet 'Plan de zones tarifaires' marked 'Valable dès le 14.12.2025' (the 'validFrom' used here).

No change of the unireso zone-10 prices on 13.12.2026 was found: nothing on unireso.com (news, tariff page), tpg.ch or the Alliance SwissPass 'Tarifmassnahmen' page on 10.11.2026. Frimobil and Onde Verte each announced their increase in a press release of 31.03.2026; no such announcement was found for unireso. The prices are therefore expected to stay, but no document dated for 2027 confirms it; 'year' stays 2026.
One zone: zone 10 'Tout Genève' is the whole network (canton of Geneva except Céligny, T651.11 2.1). The single price is stored under '1' and under 'all'.
No adult weekly pass and no FlexiAbo. The junior pass exists in 2nd class only (T651.11 3.2: a 1st class pass is bought in the adult category). The senior price is also that of AI pensioners.

Not stored: 'Saut de puce' (3 stops, CHF 2.0 / 1.8 reduced, 2nd class, tpg lines only), day pass from 9 a.m. (8.0 / 13.6; reduced 5.6 / 9.6), Adulte Duo, Jeune famille and transferable passes (900 / 1530 a year, 100 / 170 a month).
Transcribed by script from the pdftotext -layout output; checks in SOURCES.md. State subsidies are listed under 'discounts' and not applied.

text: The unireso tariff applies to trips entirely on the services of zone 10 (T651.11 1.1.2). Tickets are valid from the first to the last stop in zone 10 (2.1).
Single ticket 'Billet zone 10 Tout Genève': 60 minutes (T651.11 9.1.1). Day pass: until 5 a.m. the next day; at full price it is valid for two people on Saturdays and Sundays (3.1).
The annual pass is not a multiple of the monthly pass (adult 500 against 70 a month: 7.1 months).

Across the border the Léman Pass tariff T651.12 applies (T651.11 7.1): combinations of a route and zones (Z+P+Z), a route only (P), or adjoining zones on both sides of the border (Z+Z), inside the Léman Pass perimeter only; if the origin or the destination lies outside it, Léman Pass does not apply. A zone-10 ticket and a separate ticket for an adjoining French zone do not replace a Léman Pass ticket (0.1.3.1).

Holders of a unireso ticket or pass can add a 'billet complémentaire Léman Pass' for an adjoining French zone: 2nd class CHF 1.60 (zones 200, 210, 230, 240, 250; reduced 1.30, zone 210 1.60); 1st class in trains 2.90 (zone 210) or 2.30 (zones 230, 240) (T651.11 7.2.3, 7.2.4).
Chêne-Bourg – Annemasse by train is sold at the Swiss national tariff, Bellegarde – Genève-Cornavin at the French TER tariff (T651.11 7.1.1).
Reduced ticket price: children 6 to 15.99, seniors from AHV age, half-fare card holders (T651.11 3.1.1.2). The half-fare card gives no reduction on passes.

ages.senior: 64+ (women) / 65+ (men) at the start of validity (3.2.1.3); AI pensioners of any age pay the same price (3.2.1.4)
ages.tickets: full price from 16; reduced: children 6–15.99, seniors from AHV age, half-fare card holders; under 6 free

discounts.label: State of Geneva: youth pass paid in full
discounts.condition: one of: under 18 and resident of the canton of Geneva; 18 to 24 and resident of Geneva, in education (in or outside the canton) or with an income up to CHF 50 000 a year; 6 to 24, resident outside Geneva and in education in Geneva. Covers CHF 400 on the unireso zone-10 junior pass.

discounts.condition: AHV pensioner or AI beneficiary (any age) resident of the canton of Geneva; CHF 200 off the annual senior/AI pass (400 to 200)
